sourceFile: 20. TIU C11-20  Report test Frame mold #2 -#3 each by cavty 2026.1.27_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misgroups the frame-mold validation and invents mixed changed conditions.
issues: Changed factor conflates Normal, mold IDs, LEFT, model text, and row numbers.
Baseline Normal does not apply to all per-cavity mold comparison rows.
Cavity and mold pair context is not preserved as subgroup keys.
Measurement outcomes are derived from defect-count tables and appear invalid.
Review title is a raw data row, not a case summary.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to frame mold condition comparison for TIU-C11-20 function testing.
Separate or clearly subgroup Normal summary rows from #1 vs #2 and #2 vs #3 cavity tables.
Remove LEFT, numeric row labels, and model text from changedCondition unless row context proves them factors.
Keep Input, OK, NG categories, Total NG, and NG rate as function-defect outcomes only.
Rewrite title and citations around purpose, result headers, condition rows, and cavity rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient for final evidence.
